verdict: Clean: the Sea's crown. Cleared with four stars and no fall, no console error, every spot reachable; the Sun Warden (the Raid's boss, its own model, alone in the Sun Court) fought and fell to the bot on the first try; the rival (Isolde), the trial and the gate (Shiori) all played.
